style: 3D animated satire, deadpan slapstick; penguin fills two thirds of frame height

subject.character: ONE neat emperor penguin accountant, black tailcoat, bow tie, orange beak; same face throughout, fully serious

props.kit: round glass cupping jars; hand gas burner, blue flame; cotton wicks taped on his back
props.leaflets: white leaflets printed ДЕКЛАРАЦИЯ in black Cyrillic capitals

environment: small ice floe, dense pressure ridges with icicles, deep blue water
lighting: low polar sun behind-left, gold glints; cold blue sky glow behind-right; flares on every move

light_events.event: rotor shadows strobe across the floe

motion_rule: camera orbits them, new shot size every beat, never parked; he moves his whole body and the walrus acts every beat

audio.delivery: flat low brisk male voice, native, no accent
audio.pacing: brisk, each line once inside its beat, no pause after Я; after 4.75 rotor roar, gasps, glass clinks, pops, no words

timeline.a: medium low, orbit left; he belly-slides in along the ridge; the walrus, jar bag on a tusk, clicks on a gas burner
waist shot, orbit right; he brakes with his flippers, springs up; the walrus lumbers after him, flame roaring
medium, orbit left; he trips on flat ice, flails, waddles on; the walrus follows, burner high
medium, counter-arc; he waddles round the walrus, flippers flapping; the walrus swings after him, flame lights a wick on his back
waist shot, orbit to his side; he bolts across the floe, gasps a breath puff; the walrus belly-bounds after him, claps a jar over the lit wick on his back, pop, it sucks tight, he hops
medium, arc; he spins on his heel, waddles along the edge; the walrus lights a second wick on his back, claps a jar on, pop, he hops
low medium, swift orbit; helicopter skids drop to top frame edge, spray bursts; he is knocked flat, spins on his belly, two jars on his back; the walrus digs tusks into the ice
waist shot, arc, leaflets pour from the helicopter; a leaflet slaps his face, he spins, peels it off; one sticks to the walrus's tusks
waist shot, orbit; he reads it, gasps, beak wide, staggers back; the walrus snatches two jars

medium, arc, his face to camera; the walrus belly-flops in from frame edge, lights two wicks on his back, slaps two jars on, pop, pop; he hops ahead at each pop, ends half-turned to camera, four jars on his back
medium, arc left; he scrambles across the floe, flippers windmilling, jars clinking; the walrus bounds after him, burner blazing
waist shot, arc right; he whips round, a back jar clanks the walrus's tusk; the walrus reels, his jar bag bursts, jars roll
low medium, arc; he skids, waddles on, kicks a rolling jar; the walrus heaves up, grabs a leaflet, lunges
waist shot, short arc in; he skids to a halt half-turned to camera, four jars on his back, calmly fixes his bow tie; the walrus slaps the leaflet on his chest

must_appear: 2.65 walrus claps a jar over a lit wick on his back, pop; 4.75 rotor shadows, skids at top edge, spray; 5.45 leaflets ДЕКЛАРАЦИЯ; 6.70 jars pop onto his back, face to camera
negative_prompt: static camera, aerial shot, locked-off shots, subtitles, watermark, jar labels, digits, duplicate penguins, two walruses, floating jars, hero seen only from behind, a jar held up to the lens, a repeated word, speech after 4.9, English speech, foreign accent, extra limbs, a jar on his beak, burnt feathers
